icon:
Create one premium original mobile dark fantasy RPG app icon for "Ashen Vow: The Hollow Below". Square 1:1, full bleed, no rounded corners baked into the image. NO text, NO letters, NO people, NO faces, NO eyes, NO skull.
Hero object: a single ancient wrought-iron lantern with a very recognizable angular Gothic silhouette, a broad octagonal frame of worn antique brass, suspended in front of a thin BROKEN circular halo. Inside: a powerful ivory-orange flame shaped subtly like a rising oath, one core source of light. Silhouette should read instantly at 48 pixels, prioritize large strong shapes over tiny ornament. Lantern occupies central 68 percent, halo inside safe central 80 percent, generous dark edge margin. Three or four tiny drifting embers, restrained.
Art direction: expensive hand-painted AAA dark fantasy key art with dimensional material rendering, weathered metal, rich soot-black / charcoal stone background, bone-white hot center, warm old gold and dark crimson undertones. Dramatic directional rim light and controlled bloom. Deep blacks, excellent small-size contrast, crisp central object. Absolutely no green or teal cast. No photorealistic people, no UI, no borders, no badges, no sword clutter. Feels ominous and noble, a relic that remembers your name. Finished polished icon, not concept sketch.
featureBackground:
Create one NEW original cinematic key-art background for the Google Play feature graphic of ASHEN VOW: THE HOLLOW BELOW. Wide 2.048:1 composition. No text, no logos, no UI. The world: Vesper's Rest, a lantern-lit town built beneath a colossal ruined Gothic sanctuary over drowned catacombs. Rain-wet slate rooftops, old arches, a broken bridge and immense sanctuary spires fading into smoky silver mist. A single traveler on the RIGHT THIRD, shown entirely FROM BEHIND: deep black hood, layered worn black armor, long weathered cloak, gloved hand carrying a little brass lantern. No visible facial skin, eyes or exposed face. Traveler comparatively small, the architecture is the hero. Intriguing distant pale light beyond the sanctuary rose window, oppressive scale, fine environmental storytelling.

Key architecture and traveler on the RIGHT half. Warm lantern glow punctuates the rightmost lower middle. Important visual subject within middle 80 percent safe area, no essential details at borders. Foreground stone detail and a few floating ash flecks. Dramatic editorial image that feels like an expensive dark fantasy book cover, meticulous materials, layered atmospheric perspective, natural cinematic light, perfectly finished. No promotional words, no badges, no figures facing camera.
hook: Create one original vertical 9:16 dark fantasy cinematic illustration for the mobile RPG "Ashen Vow: The Hollow Below". No text, no logo, no UI. This is the opening story visual: beneath an immense drowned Gothic sanctuary, a giant ancient bronze funeral bell hangs crooked over a black flooded stairwell. In the foreground an open weathered ledger lies on a wet stone plinth with faint hand-drawn unrecognizable scribbles, and a tiny brass lantern beside it. The silence has broken after thirty years. A lone traveler is visible in the distance at the edge of the stairwell ONLY FROM THE BACK: opaque deep black hood, layered black armor, gloves and a weathered cloak, no exposed face, no skin, no visible eyes. Camera has monumental vertical scale, strong dramatic perspective, the bell in upper central third and descending spiral stairs in lower third. Beautiful painterly AAA dark fantasy key art, ash-gray stone, soot-black shadows, antique brass, pale ivory light and sparse warm ember glow, muted crimson reflections. NO green or teal. Mist is soft and clean, no visual noise. The bottom 20% fades into rich near-black to receive English typography later. Cinematic high contrast, tactile stone and metal, ominous elegance, sharp focal details, no gore, no extra characters.
